name: Hollow Saint
author: SammiBabe666
description: Hollow Saint by SammiBabe666 is a hurdy-gurdy in a cathedral. Each note is a bowed melody string. Under it run two drone strings, root and fifth, and the trompette, a string whose buzzing bridge slaps on the strokes of the wheel. The wheel turns in time with the OP-1's tempo. Then the sound goes into a stone room that darkens and rings, and turned up high it strikes a distant bell on each note. It's all synthesis, no samples.
credits: SammiBabe666's Cathedral of the Hollow Saint, brought into kennel by Hundekraft
